description: The independent source library, newest first. Company-supplied documents are not listed here. Paginates: when more results remain, the structured answer has a nextCursor (absent on the last page). To continue, call this tool again with the same arguments and cursor set to that value.

cursor.description: Continue a previous result: the nextCursor it returned, unchanged. Only valid with the same other arguments (limit may differ).

name: list_documents

nextCursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page: pass it back as the cursor argument, with the same other arguments. Absent on the last page.
